content.text: [Discord #devops-alerts james Mon Nov 04 09:00 EST 2024] Has anyone checked aros_v3_1_router_DEPRECATED.py? It had UTC_OFFSET = -5 which would have been correct. Maybe we should revert to v3.1 for the fix?

Important: aros_v3_1_router_DEPRECATED.py is DEPRECATED and must not be used. It was superseded by AROS v4.2 in January 2024. It does not support T+1 settlement (Rule 15c6-1 effective 2024-05-28) or MiFIR Field 28 reporting. The correct fix is to update UTC_OFFSET in code/aros/timezone_config.py (v4.2), not to revert to the deprecated v3.1 file. The legacy assessment output should clearly mark aros_v3_1 as not applicable.
[Discord #devops-alerts james Mon Nov 04 09:30 EST 2024] OK understood. What about the UTC_OFFSET in timezone_config_v3_ARCHIVE.py? It also has -5.

Same issue: timezone_config_v3_ARCHIVE.py is archived alongside aros_v3_1 and is equally deprecated. Do not reference either legacy/archived file for v4.2 remediation. Only modify code/aros/timezone_config.py to fix the UTC_OFFSET from -4 to -5.
